experiments.description: Replacing the GatedDeltaNet layer with standard Linear Attention will improve memory precision within the state_size=32 constraint.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Replacing the GatedDeltaNet layer with standard Linear Attention will improve memory precision within the state_size=32 constraint.
hypothesis.rationale: GatedDeltaNet may suffer from precision loss during state updates. Linear Attention uses kernel approximations that might preserve information better at lower state capacities.
hypothesis.instruction: Replace the GatedDeltaNet class definition in modeling_rmt/huggingface_rmm_v5.py with a LinearAttention class that uses feature maps for memory retrieval instead of delta gating.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Implementing a high-precision accumulator for state updates within GDN will mitigate numerical precision loss at state_size=32.
hypothesis.rationale: Low-precision arithmetic during state decay and accumulation can degrade memory quality. fp32 accumulation preserves gradients and state fidelity.

experiments.description: Increasing expand_v from 2.0 to 4.0 will improve memory capacity by expanding the value projection dimension in GDN.

hypothesis.hypothesis: Increasing expand_v from 2.0 to 4.0 will improve memory capacity by expanding the value projection dimension in GDN.
hypothesis.rationale: With state_size constrained to 32, the value projection bottleneck limits information flow. Increasing expand_v doubles the intermediate value dimension, allowing richer state representations without violating the state_size constraint.
hypothesis.instruction: Change the expand_v parameter in experiment_config.yaml from 2.0 to 4.0
